Questions

Before you switch

How do I bring my OneDrive files over?

+

Set your OneDrive folder to Always keep on this device, or download your files from the web. In Uncloud, choose Add files, then This computer, and select the downloaded folder.

Does Uncloud replace Word, Excel or Outlook?

+

No. Uncloud stores your files. Microsoft 365 apps and Outlook mail remain separate.

Does everyone get their own space?

+

Yes. Each person gets their own account and private files. Unlimited household members and devices are included.

How much storage do I get?

+

As much as your computer and connected drives can hold. Add a bigger drive when you need more room. No storage tiers or per-person charges.

What does Uncloud cost?

+

Join early access to lock in $79 at launch ($99 regular), paid once. Household members, devices, remote access, file migration and updates are included. No payment today; try it free for 30 days when you get access.
